speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The Constitution requires the legislature to provide a Civil List for the maintenance of the President and his office.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: It ensures that the President has sufficient budget to operate his office and hire his staff.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The Civil List was last adjusted in FY2022 and has remained unchanged since.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: It is thus necessary to move this Motion to adjust the Civil List.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The proposed changes are in Class 2, Class 3 and Class 4 of the Civil List to enable the President's office to continue to meet its expenditure needs.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The variations also arise as we have re-categorised some expenditures to better reflect the nature of those expenditures.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The proposed adjustment is to cater for the increases in expenditure in manpower.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The increase is partially offset as it is proposed to categorise expenditure for manpower for public officers seconded to the President's office under Class 4 instead of Class 2.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This is because these public officers who are seconded to the President's office are not part of the President's personal staff.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This is to cater for the higher cost of maintaining and securing IT systems as well as organising official events at the Istana, while the main building of the Istana undergoes major restoration works.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: As explained earlier, this arises because expenditure on manpower for public officers seconded to the President's office will now be categorised under Class 4.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The question is as moved by the Minister.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: I assume no one wishes to speak on this?
